title: POST /v1/projects/{projectId}/imports request
description: Imports a reference file the researcher uploaded to private R2 via POST /v1/projects/{projectId}/import-uploads (contract addition 2026-11-23, see ../contract-additions.md and import-upload.response.json). The API parses it deterministically (T0 code, no LLM), normalises each entry, and files one search run with database import plus one record per entry. Owner, editor or analyst only.
